title: Structure packaging coherent homomorphism data
statement: A structure packaging the open, transition maps, restriction isomorphisms, cocone, and bijective colimit map used in Lemma 01YB.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01YB (label lemma-homs-over-open); its proof uses Properties lemma-sections-over-quasi-compact-open, lemma-quasi-coherent-colimit-finite-type, Lemmas 01Y8 (lemma-acc-coherent), Artin-Rees (lemma-Artin-Rees) and the quasi-coherence of the sheaf Hom from a finitely presented module

proof_origin.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01YB (label lemma-homs-over-open, line 2621) and its proof (lines 2649-2743); the two places the source omits (I^nK = 0, injectivity of the first arrow) are written out by the agent in Steps 10 and 13, and the map, the restrictions to U and the finiteness facts (Steps 1, 2) are made explicit
